text: The deadline is in ten minutes and the report is only half written. She types faster, glancing at the clock between sentences, deleting nothing.
Sunday afternoon stretches ahead with nothing planned. He waters the plants slowly, then reads a chapter on the porch before deciding whether to nap.
The gate agent announces final boarding while he is still three moving walkways away, weaving through the crowd with his bag banging against his knee.
The archivist reshelves returned volumes one at a time, pausing to flatten a bent corner and note a repair for later in the week.
